newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to Feb 23.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to Feb 23.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - TO FEB 23
The following is a one-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.

AMSTERDAM - Dutch European Union presidency hosts experts meeting on public service broadcasting in Europe; main discussions focus on the role of public service broadcasting in the information society; public financing of public service broadcasting in relation to the treaty and EC competition policy; international cooperation between public service broadcasters (To Feb 18)
LONDON - Channel 5 hosts its programme launch. 1230 GMT
LONDON - Incentive World '97, Wembley Exhibition Centre. (first day of three-day exhibition)
AMSTERDAM - Dutch EU presidency hosts experts meeting on public service broadcasting in Europe; news conference on the outcome of the meeting 1200 GMT (Final day).
LONDON - Incentive World '97, Wembley Exhibiton Centre. (second day of three-day exhibition).
LONDON - WPP Group Plc reports 1996 full year results.
LONDON - Incentive World '97, Wembley Exhibition Centre. (final day of three-day exhibition).
LONDON - Outdoor Advertising Conference, St. James Court Hotel.

Please send entries to: Reuters Advertising & Media Diary, Advertising Newsdesk, Reuters Ltd, 85 Fleet Street, London EC4P 4 AJ; fax (44) 171 542 2929; telephone (44) 171 542 2792; email: adnewslon@reuters.com.
